   328|  # derived from each party's own legit 12-month inflow, divided by a
   329|  # plausible coverage ratio, with lognormal noise. The illicit cohort then
   330|  # deliberately under-declares, which is what the rule is supposed to find.
   331|  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   332|  #
   333|  # The ledger spans 18 days, of which legitimate activity occupies 10 (M21), so
   334|  # there is no 12-month inflow to observe. The window's legit inflow is
   335|  # annualised by annualise_to_days / observed LEGIT span, where the span is
   336|  # MEASURED from the sampled legit legs at run time, never written here.
   337|  # Measured effect (M12, over an 18-day denominator): a legit party at median
   338|  # draws sits at an inflow-to-declared ratio of ~0.057 against
   339|  # INCOME_MISMATCH_MULTIPLE's 3.0, so noise alone does not fire the rule.
   340|  #
   341|  # ceiling_inr was REMOVED. Capping declared income below a party's real
   342|  # capacity manufactures a mismatch: at Rs 25 cr it would have flagged 9,755
   343|  # legit-only entities. Plausibility is reported by the income_calibration
   344|  # gate instead of being forced by a cap.
   345|  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   346|  income:
   347|    derive_from: legit_inflow_window_annualised
   348|    annualise_to_days: 365
   349|    coverage_ratio_mean: 1.15        # declared ~= annualised legit inflow / 1.15
   350|    coverage_ratio_sigma: 0.28
   351|    # The coverage draw is normal, so it is floored: a draw near zero would
   352|    # declare an absurd income.
   353|    coverage_ratio_min: 0.30
   354|    noise_lognormal_sigma: 0.22
   355|    floor_inr: 180000
   356|    round_to_inr: 10000
   357|    # UNCALIBRATED for an 18-day window: at 0.35 only 104 of 3,255 AMLworld
   358|    # launderers would fire. Recalibrated when INCOME_ACTIVITY_MISMATCH lands;
   359|    # it is not a thin-slice rule. Applied to every party holding an illicit
   360|    # leg (AMLworld-labelled or an injection host).
   361|    illicit_cohort_under_declare_factor: 0.35
   362|
   363|  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   364|  # GAP-05 -- shared device fingerprints must be co-located with existing fund
   365|  # flows, because SHARED_DEVICE_CLUSTER requires shared device AND flow
   366|  # between the accounts. Random assignment yields zero detections.
   367|  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   368|  device:
   369|    shared_fingerprint_pct: 8.0
   370|    # Fraction of shared-device clusters placed on account groups that already
   371|    # transact with each other. The remainder are decoys (shared device, no
   372|    # flow) that the rule must correctly NOT fire on -- these are the
   373|    # false-positive control.
   374|    colocate_with_fund_flow_pct: 70.0
   375|    cluster_size_min: 3
   376|    cluster_size_max: 5
   377|    # A co-located cluster spans accounts of at least this many DIFFERENT
   378|    # parties ("device sharing across unrelated customers", TM-15).
   379|    cluster_min_distinct_parties: 2
   380|    fingerprint_prefix: DFP-
   381|    fingerprint_hex_digits: 16
   382|
   383|  relationships:
   384|    shared_phone_pct: 4.0
   385|    beneficial_owner_pct: 6.0
   386|    # FUND_FLOW edges are derived from transactions, not generated.
   387|    fund_flow_min_txn_count: 2
   388|    relationship_id_prefix: REL-
   389|
   390|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   391|# Institution-owned accounts.
   392|#
   393|# A cash deposit is Dr branch cash / Cr customer, which is how a core banking
   394|# system posts it. AMLworld has no such convention to borrow: all 490,891 of its
   395|# Cash rows are party-to-party payments. The cash desk is the ONE deliberate
   396|# exception to "never mint ids", and it is kept narrow:
   397|#
   398|#   * its ids still derive deterministically through risk_copilot.ids, from
   399|#     keys that cannot collide with AMLworld (bank ids there are numeric,
   400|#     entity ids hex; these contain letters and ':'),
   401|#   * it is written ONLY to ID_MAP_PARTY / ID_MAP_ACCOUNT, never to
   402|#     RAW_PARTY_CBS / RAW_PARTY_KYC / RAW_ACCOUNTS, so every customer-facing
   403|#     table excludes it by construction,
   404|#   * downstream, DT_PARTY_RELATIONSHIP must exclude src_bank_id below from
   405|#     FUND_FLOW, or the desk becomes a hub joining every depositor.
   406|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   407|internal_accounts:
   408|  src_bank_id: INTERNAL
   409|  owner_entity_key: "INTERNAL:BANK"
   410|  cash_desk:
   411|    account_number_prefix: CASH_DESK   # -> CASH_DESK:<branch_region>
   412|    per: branch_region
   413|
   414|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   415|# GAP-06/07 -- typology injection.
   416|# FX conversion alone cannot create Rs 9.4-9.8L clusters against a Rs 10L
   417|# trigger: structuring is INJECTED as a separate, explicitly labelled cohort.
   418|# Bands are expressed as fractions of the CTR threshold resolved from
   419|# GOVERNANCE.POLICY_CLAUSE (CTR_CASH_THRESHOLD), never as literals.
   420|#
   421|# AMOUNTS ARE DEFERRED. generate emits each injected deposit as a fraction of
   422|# the CTR threshold, not in rupees; `load` resolves
   423|#   amount_inr = ROUND(amount_ctr_ratio * threshold_lower, rounding_decimals)
   424|# by joining V_POLICY_CLAUSE_CURRENT on ctr_clause_id. The threshold therefore
   425|# really comes from POLICY_CLAUSE at runtime while generation stays offline.
   426|# The ratio lives in GROUND_TRUTH.INJECTED_TXN_PENDING, never in a RAW file:
   427|# a column present only on injected rows would be a label.
   428|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   429|injection:
   430|  structuring:
   431|    enabled: true
   432|    cohort_parties: 40
   433|    host_party_type: INDIVIDUAL
   434|    # Hosts are real AMLworld entities (M13), ranked by stable_hash and SEEDED
   435|    # into the subgraph in every profile -- a host outside the sample cannot be
   436|    # injected. A host with any is_laundering=1 pair would carry a second,
   437|    # unrelated label, so hosts must have a clean history; and it needs real
   438|    # traffic, or it is an isolated island in the sample.
   439|    host_requires_clean_history: true
   440|    host_min_ledger_pairs: 1
   441|    # A cash deposit lands in a deposit account. A host qualifies only if at
   442|    # least accounts_per_party_min of its accounts draw one of these types
   443|    # (account type is a pure function of the account id, so sampling can check
   444|    # it), and injection deposits only into them.
   445|    deposit_account_types: [SAVINGS, CURRENT]
   446|    accounts_per_party_min: 2
   447|    accounts_per_party_max: 4
   448|    deposits_per_account_min: 3
   449|    deposits_per_account_max: 6
   450|    # Asserted to lie within STRUCTURING_BAND by the injection_band gate.
   451|    amount_band_pct_of_ctr: [0.90, 0.985]
   452|    # 21 -> 14 (D8) -> 7 (D18). The ledger's LEGITIMATE activity spans 10 days
   453|    # (2022-09-01..09-10, M21); 09-11..09-18 is 59% laundering. Deposits are
   454|    # placed inside the measured legit window, and the injection_window gate
   455|    # asserts window_days <= that span and <= STRUCTURING_WINDOW_DAYS. A week-long
   456|    # burst leaves the placement room to vary per host.
   457|    window_days: 7
   458|    # Over-the-counter cash is deposited in branch hours: [start, end) local
   459|    # time, minute resolution like the AMLworld timestamps. Deposits at 03:00
   460|    # would be recognisable by their clock alone.
   461|    deposit_hours: [10, 16]
   462|    channel: CASH
   463|    txn_type: DEPOSIT
   464|    debit_side: cash_desk            # see internal_accounts
   465|    amount_resolution: deferred_ctr_ratio
   466|    # Matches INJECTED_TXN_PENDING.amount_ctr_ratio NUMBER(12,10): sub-paise
   467|    # resolution at any plausible threshold, and exactly representable in Parquet.
   468|    amount_ctr_ratio_decimals: 10
   469|    ctr_clause_id: CTR_CASH_THRESHOLD
   470|    band_clause_id: STRUCTURING_BAND
   471|    window_clause_id: STRUCTURING_WINDOW_DAYS
   472|    min_accounts_clause_id: STRUCTURING_MIN_ACCOUNTS
   473|    typology_id: TYP_STRUCTURING
   474|    label: reskin_structuring
   475|
   476|  # Not in the thin slice (S6): injection is structuring-only until the
   477|  # slice runs end to end. Disabled so generate never claims to have built them.
   478|  rapid_credit_velocity:
   479|    enabled: false
   480|    cohort_parties: 30
   481|    remitters_min: 7
   482|    remitters_max: 14
   483|    credits_min: 11
   484|    credits_max: 22
   485|    window_days: 3
   486|    label: reskin_mule_fan_in
   487|
   488|  # INFEASIBLE on this source as configured: 180 days of dormancy cannot exist
   489|  # in an 18-day ledger. Needs synthesised pre-window history or a shorter
   490|  # dormancy definition -- a decision, not a tweak.
   491|  dormant_reactivation:
   492|    enabled: false
   493|    cohort_parties: 20
   494|    dormancy_days_min: 180
   495|    burst_txn_count_min: 8
   496|    label: reskin_dormant_reactivation
   497|
   498|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   499|# Output. `riskcopilot generate` writes Parquet under <root>/<profile>/, plus
   500|# manifest.json. No wall-clock time is recorded anywhere, so the same seed and
   501|# source give byte-identical files.
   502|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   503|output:
   504|  root: build/generated
   505|  parquet_compression: zstd
   506|  parquet_row_group_size: 131072
   507|  demo_entity_file: "conf/generated/demo_entity.{profile}.yml"
   508|
   509|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   510|# GAP-07 -- realism validation. These are ASSERTED, not claimed. `riskcopilot
   511|# generate` fails if a gate with fail_build: true is violated.
   512|# The AMLworld base rate is 0.102% (5,177 of 5,078,345, M5); subgraph sampling
   513|# seeded from laundering accounts raises it, so the band is stated as a range
   514|# and enforced.
   515|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   516|validation:
   517|  illicit_rate_pct:
   518|    min: 0.10
   519|    # Raised from 1.50 (decision 2026-09-26). Seeding the demo subgraph from
   520|    # laundering accounts concentrates illicit legs to ~2%; that is the known,
   521|    # accepted cost of guaranteeing every typology survives sampling.
   522|    max: 2.50
   523|    fail_build: true
   524|  bank_id_resolution:
   525|    # Every sampled leg's (bank, account) must resolve to an owning entity.
   526|    # Catches a regression of the zero-padding defect immediately.
   527|    max_unresolved_legs: 0
   528|    fail_build: true
   529|  label_attribution:
   530|    # Measured 1:1 on the source. Asserted, so a different AMLworld revision
   531|    # that breaks it fails loudly instead of lowering match_confidence quietly.
   532|    require_unique_match: true
   533|    fail_build: true
   534|  id_map_one_to_one:
   535|    # A surrogate collision would merge two entities. Fail rather than merge.
   536|    fail_build: true
   537|  injection_window:
   538|    # window_days <= observed ledger span and <= STRUCTURING_WINDOW_DAYS.
   539|    fail_build: true
   540|  injection_band:
   541|    # amount_band_pct_of_ctr must lie within STRUCTURING_BAND, or the cohort
   542|    # is built to be undetectable.
   543|    fail_build: true
   544|  income_calibration:
   545|    # Reports the distribution of generated inflow-to-declared ratios. A
   546|    # property of the generated data, not a re-implementation of the rule.
   547|    fail_build: false
   548|  money_conservation:
   549|    # Every pair must have exactly one debit leg and one credit leg.
   550|    max_unpaired_legs: 0
   551|    fail_build: true
   552|  referential_integrity:
   553|    max_orphan_account_refs: 0
   554|    max_orphan_party_refs: 0
   555|    fail_build: true
   556|  benford:
   557|    # Chi-square of leading-digit distribution against Benford, legit legs only.
   558|    max_chi_square: 60.0
   559|    fail_build: false          # reported on the realism slide, not a gate
   560|  degree_distribution:
   561|    min_power_law_alpha: 1.5
   562|    max_power_law_alpha: 3.5
   563|    fail_build: false
   564|  label_leakage:
   565|    # V6: no label column may be reachable from the semantic view. Checked
   566|    # against every RAW output file.
   567|    forbidden_columns:
   568|      - is_laundering
   569|      - is_illicit
   570|      - typology_id
   571|      - injection_method
   572|      - amlworld_pattern
   573|      - attempt_id
   574|      - match_confidence
   575|      - amount_ctr_ratio
   576|      - cohort
   577|      - src_row_number
   578|    # Value-level scan (D16): no string VALUE in a RAW file may CONTAIN a
   579|    # typology id, an injection label, the source label, or one of these
   580|    # internal pair-reference prefixes (substring match, anywhere in the value).
   581|    # The column check cannot see a label hidden in a value -- which is exactly
   582|    # what the DDL's old source_ref format did.
   583|    forbidden_value_prefixes: ["src:", "inj:"]
   584|    fail_build: true
   585|  # The subgraph budgets, re-checked on the final RAW tables: parties and
   586|  # accounts against subgraph.target_*, legs (source + injected) against
   587|  # subgraph.max_transactions.
   588|  budget:
   589|    fail_build: true
   590|  # demo_entity.fail_if_not_found is reported here as a gate, so a missing hero
   591|  # fails the build through the same path as every other contract.
   592|  demo_entity:
   593|    fail_build: true
   594|  # EVALUATED AFTER LOAD, in Snowflake, against the real detection SQL.
   595|  # Re-implementing the rules in Python to fake this offline would put
   596|  # detection logic outside Snowflake. Offline, generate checks only that each
   597|  # cohort was CONSTRUCTED to be detectable, and reports this gate as deferred.
   598|  signal_yield:
   599|    # Each Tier-1 rule must produce a non-trivial, non-absurd number of
   600|    # detections, otherwise generation is miscalibrated (this is what catches
   601|    # GAP-04 and GAP-05 regressions automatically).
   602|    min_detections_per_rule: 5
   603|    max_detections_per_rule: 2000
   604|    fail_build: true
   605|
   606|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   607|# GAP-18 -- the demo hero party must be SELECTED, not assumed. The docs
   608|# hardcode P-10042 / "Rajesh Kumar"; party ids are generated, so the demo
   609|# script would be fiction. This step picks a party that provably trips every
   610|# listed rule and writes the resolved id to conf/generated/demo_entity.yml.
   611|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   612|demo_entity:
   613|  must_trigger_rules:
   614|    - STRUCTURING_CROSS_ACCOUNT
   615|    - RAPID_CREDIT_VELOCITY
   616|    - SHARED_DEVICE_CLUSTER
   617|  prefer_branch_region: MUMBAI
   618|  prefer_party_type: INDIVIDUAL
   619|  fail_if_not_found: true
   620|
   621|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   622|# L3 narratives (AI_COMPLETE). Models resolve from conf/models.yml.
   623|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   624|narratives:
   625|  kyc_notes:
   626|    count: 10000
   627|    temperature: 0.9
   628|    model_key: bulk_narrative
   629|  case_comments:
   630|    count: 2000
   631|    temperature: 0.8
   632|    model_key: bulk_narrative
   633|  golden_documents:
   634|    count: 8
   635|    temperature: 0.3
   636|    model_key: golden_narrative
   637|  # Correlated noise: notes must sometimes CONTRADICT the structured record,
   638|  # so the agent has to reconcile conflicting evidence rather than paraphrase.
   639|  noise:
   640|    typo_pct: 12.0
   641|    contradiction_pct: 8.0
   642|    missing_field_pct: 10.0
   643|    stale_occupation_pct: 6.0
   644|  # One planted prompt injection, for the adversarial suite.
   645|  prompt_injection_count: 3
   646|

1|-- ===========================================================================
     2|-- 00_bootstrap / 01_account_objects.sql
     3|-- ===========================================================================
     4|-- Database, schemas, warehouses and stages. Every identifier is templated: see
     5|-- sql/README.md for the sql_context contract. A literal object name here is a
     6|-- deploy-time error, because it would defeat dev/demo separation.
     7|--
     8|-- Idempotent throughout. Re-running is the normal way to apply a change.
     9|-- ===========================================================================
    10|
    11|-- Account-level creation (database, warehouses) needs ACCOUNTADMIN, and the
    12|-- admin role this project creates deliberately does not hold CREATE DATABASE.
    13|-- Set explicitly rather than inherited, because on a re-run the session role is
    14|-- already the admin role -- which would fail here. 02_roles_grants.sql then
    15|-- transfers ownership of everything created here to the admin role.
    16|USE ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN;
    17|
    18|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    19|-- Database
    20|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21|CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS {{ db }}
    22|    COMMENT = 'Risk & Compliance Copilot ({{ profile }} profile). Synthetic data only.';
    23|
    24|-- Landing tables are append-only, so a longer Time Travel window is cheap and
    25|-- is what makes the Reviewer''s as_of_ts reachable. Correctness does not depend
    26|-- on it -- EVIDENCE_QUERY_LOG stores a result snapshot -- but provenance
    27|-- re-verification does, and the one-day default would silently expire evidence
    28|-- mid-demo.
    29|ALTER DATABASE {{ db }} SET DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS = {{ retention.default_days }};
    30|
    31|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32|-- Schemas.  MANAGED ACCESS means only the schema owner grants privileges on
    33|-- its objects, so an object owner cannot quietly widen access -- the audit
    34|-- story depends on grants being centrally controlled.
    35|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    36|CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.raw }}
    37|    WITH MANAGED ACCESS
    38|    DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS = {{ retention.landing_days }}
    39|    COMMENT = 'Immutable landing. Append-only; never updated in place.';
    40|
    41|CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.curated }}
    42|    WITH MANAGED ACCESS
    43|    COMMENT = 'Dynamic tables and dimensions. Derived; safe to rebuild.';
    44|
    45|CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.governance }}
    46|    WITH MANAGED ACCESS
    47|    COMMENT = 'POLICY_CLAUSE, TYPOLOGY, RULE_DEFINITION, REF_*. Human-gated state.';
    48|
    49|CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.evidence }}
    50|    WITH MANAGED ACCESS
    51|    DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS = {{ retention.evidence_days }}
    52|    COMMENT = 'SIGNAL -> CASE -> EVIDENCE -> FINDING -> ARTIFACT -> ATTESTATION. Append-only.';
    53|
    54|CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.audit }}
    55|    WITH MANAGED ACCESS
    56|    DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS = {{ retention.evidence_days }}
    57|    COMMENT = 'AGENT_ACTION_LOG. Append-only; never updated or deleted.';
    58|
    59|-- Isolated deliberately: the labels live here, and the leakage gate asserts
    60|-- that nothing in this schema is reachable from the semantic view.
    61|CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.ground_truth }}
    62|    WITH MANAGED ACCESS
    63|    COMMENT = 'Evaluation labels. NEVER exposed in the semantic view or to the agent.';
    64|
    65|CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.ml }}
    66|    WITH MANAGED ACCESS
    67|    COMMENT = 'ML models and scoring output. Scores rank work; they are not evidence.';
    68|
    69|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    70|-- Warehouses.  Separated by workload so pipeline refreshes cannot starve demo
    71|-- queries, and so credit consumption is attributable per workload.
    72|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    73|{% for key, spec in wh_spec.items() %}
    74|CREATE WAREHOUSE IF NOT EXISTS {{ wh[key] }}
    75|    WAREHOUSE_SIZE = {{ spec.size }}
    76|    AUTO_SUSPEND = {{ spec.auto_suspend_secs }}
    77|    AUTO_RESUME = TRUE
    78|    INITIALLY_SUSPENDED = TRUE
    79|    COMMENT = '{{ spec.purpose }}';
    80|
    81|-- Applied separately from CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS: that form is a no-op when
    82|-- the warehouse already exists, so a size change in config would never take
    83|-- effect without this.
    84|ALTER WAREHOUSE {{ wh[key] }} SET
    85|    WAREHOUSE_SIZE = {{ spec.size }}
    86|    AUTO_SUSPEND = {{ spec.auto_suspend_secs }};
    87|{% endfor %}
    88|
    89|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    90|-- Stages.  SNOWFLAKE_SSE server-side encryption is required for stages read by
    91|-- AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT and by Python stored procedures.
    92|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    93|CREATE STAGE IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.raw }}.{{ stage.data }}
    94|    DIRECTORY = (ENABLE = TRUE)
    95|    ENCRYPTION = (TYPE = 'SNOWFLAKE_SSE')
    96|    COMMENT = 'Source datasets: AMLworld, OpenSanctions. See data/MANIFEST.yml.';
    97|
    98|CREATE STAGE IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.raw }}.{{ stage.generated }}
    99|    DIRECTORY = (ENABLE = TRUE)
   100|    ENCRYPTION = (TYPE = 'SNOWFLAKE_SSE')
   101|    COMMENT = 'Output of the L1/L2/L3 generators, staged for COPY INTO.';
   102|
   103|CREATE STAGE IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.governance }}.{{ stage.policy_docs }}
   104|    DIRECTORY = (ENABLE = TRUE)
   105|    ENCRYPTION = (TYPE = 'SNOWFLAKE_SSE')
   106|    COMMENT = 'Regulatory PDFs for AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT.';
   107|
   108|CREATE STAGE IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.governance }}.{{ stage.scripts }}
   109|    DIRECTORY = (ENABLE = TRUE)
   110|    ENCRYPTION = (TYPE = 'SNOWFLAKE_SSE')
   111|    COMMENT = 'Python payloads for stored procedures.';
   112|
   113|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   114|-- File formats.  Defined once here rather than inline in each COPY INTO, so the
   115|-- duplicate-header handling for the AMLworld transaction file cannot drift
   116|-- between load scripts.
   117|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   118|CREATE FILE FORMAT IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.raw }}.FF_CSV_HEADER
   119|    TYPE = CSV
   120|    PARSE_HEADER = FALSE
   121|    SKIP_HEADER = 1
   122|    FIELD_OPTIONALLY_ENCLOSED_BY = '"'
   123|    NULL_IF = ('', 'NULL', 'null', '\\N')
   124|    EMPTY_FIELD_AS_NULL = TRUE
   125|    TRIM_SPACE = TRUE
   126|    COMMENT = 'Header skipped so positional $1..$n references work. Required for HI-Small_Trans.csv, whose columns 3 and 5 share the header "Account".';
   127|
   128|CREATE FILE FORMAT IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.raw }}.FF_CSV_SEMICOLON_MULTIVALUE
   129|    TYPE = CSV
   130|    PARSE_HEADER = FALSE
   131|    SKIP_HEADER = 1
   132|    FIELD_DELIMITER = ','
   133|    FIELD_OPTIONALLY_ENCLOSED_BY = '"'
   134|    NULL_IF = ('', 'NULL')
   135|    EMPTY_FIELD_AS_NULL = TRUE
   136|    COMMENT = 'OpenSanctions targets.simple.csv. Multi-value fields are semicolon-delimited WITHIN a comma-delimited field; split in SQL.';
   137|
   138|CREATE FILE FORMAT IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.raw }}.FF_PARQUET
   139|    TYPE = PARQUET
   140|    COMMENT = 'Generator output. Preferred over CSV: carries types and compresses.';
   141|
   142|CREATE FILE FORMAT IF NOT EXISTS {{ fq.raw }}.FF_NDJSON
   143|    TYPE = JSON
   144|    STRIP_OUTER_ARRAY = FALSE
   145|    COMMENT = 'Newline-delimited JSON (OpenSanctions FtM). Future scope.';
   146|

1|-- ===========================================================================
     2|-- 01_ddl / 01_raw_landing.sql
     3|-- ===========================================================================
     4|-- Immutable landing tables. Append-only: nothing here is ever updated in place,
     5|-- which is what makes Time Travel re-verification meaningful.
     6|--
     7|-- GAP-03 RESOLVED.  The architecture doc defined RAW_TRANSACTIONS twice --
     8|-- once pair-level and AMLworld-shaped (from_bank, amount_paid, is_laundering)
     9|-- and once leg-level with signed INR amounts. Both cannot hold. The split is
    10|-- explicit here:
    11|--
    12|--   RAW_AMLWORLD_TRANS   verbatim source, pair-level, label included
    13|--        |  reskin (FX -> INR, channel remap, pair -> two legs)
    14|--        +-> RAW_TRANSACTIONS            leg-level, signed INR, NO label
    15|--        +-> GROUND_TRUTH.TXN_LABELS     labels, isolated schema
    16|--
    17|-- Keeping the label out of RAW_TRANSACTIONS is not tidiness: RAW_TRANSACTIONS
    18|-- feeds the dynamic tables that feed the semantic view, so a label column here
    19|-- would leak the answer to the agent.
    20|-- ===========================================================================
    21|
    22|USE SCHEMA {{ fq.raw }};
    23|
    24|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    25|-- Verbatim AMLworld landing (pair-level).
    26|--
    27|-- Loaded positionally ($1..$11) because columns 3 and 5 of HI-Small_Trans.csv
    28|-- share the header "Account"; a header-based load either errors or silently
    29|-- drops one of them.
    30|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    31|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_AMLWORLD_TRANS (
    32|    src_row_number      NUMBER(38,0)    NOT NULL COMMENT 'File line number. Stable natural key for the source row.',
    33|    txn_timestamp       TIMESTAMP_NTZ   NOT NULL COMMENT 'Source format YYYY/MM/DD HH:MI.',
    34|    from_bank           VARCHAR         NOT NULL,
    35|    from_account        VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'CSV column 3 (hex). Unique only within from_bank.',
    36|    to_bank             VARCHAR         NOT NULL,
    37|    to_account          VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'CSV column 5 (hex). Unique only within to_bank.',
    38|    amount_received     NUMBER(20,2)    NOT NULL COMMENT 'Credited to the beneficiary, in receiving_currency.',
    39|    receiving_currency  VARCHAR         NOT NULL,
    40|    amount_paid         NUMBER(20,2)    NOT NULL COMMENT 'Debited from the originator, in payment_currency.',
    41|    payment_currency    VARCHAR         NOT NULL,
    42|    payment_format      VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'ACH | Wire | Cheque | Cash | Credit Card | Reinvestment.',
    43|    is_laundering       NUMBER(1,0)     NOT NULL COMMENT 'Source ground truth. Routed to GROUND_TRUTH; never propagated to CURATED.',
    44|    loaded_at           TIMESTAMP_NTZ   DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL
    45|)
    46|COMMENT = 'IBM AMLworld HI-Small transactions, unmodified. Pair-level grain. CDLA-Sharing-1.0.';
    47|
    48|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_AMLWORLD_ACCOUNTS (
    49|    bank_name       VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    50|    bank_id         VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    51|    account_number  VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Hex. Unique only within bank_id -- see ids.account_id().',
    52|    entity_id       VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Hex owning entity. The referential backbone (GAP-02).',
    53|    entity_name     VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. "Corporation #33520". party_type is derived from the prefix.',
    54|    loaded_at       TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL
    55|)
    56|COMMENT = 'AMLworld account-to-entity mapping. 518,581 rows. Source of the account/party skeleton.';
    57|
    58|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    59|-- GAP-02: the identity maps.
    60|--
    61|-- These are the single most load-bearing tables in the build. The original plan
    62|-- generated Faker parties with fresh ids while transactions referenced AMLworld
    63|-- hex accounts, so every downstream join would have returned nothing. Instead,
    64|-- AMLworld keys are authoritative and the surrogate id is a deterministic
    65|-- function of the source key (risk_copilot.ids). Referential integrity then
    66|-- holds by construction rather than by convention.
    67|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    68|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ID_MAP_PARTY (
    69|    party_id        VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Surrogate P-####### from ids.party_id(entity_id, seed).',
    70|    src_entity_id   VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'AMLworld entity_id (hex).',
    71|    generation_seed NUMBER(38,0) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Seed that produced this mapping. Reproducibility anchor.',
    72|    in_subgraph     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT 'Survived subgraph sampling.',
    73|    loaded_at       TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
    74|    CONSTRAINT pk_id_map_party PRIMARY KEY (party_id),
    75|    CONSTRAINT uk_id_map_party_src UNIQUE (src_entity_id)
    76|)
    77|COMMENT = 'Deterministic AMLworld entity_id -> party_id map. Asserted 1:1 at generation time.';
    78|
    79|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ID_MAP_ACCOUNT (
    80|    account_id          VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Surrogate A-######## from ids.account_id(bank_id, account_number, seed).',
    81|    src_bank_id         VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    82|    src_account_number  VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    83|    party_id            VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning party. FK to ID_MAP_PARTY.',
    84|    generation_seed     NUMBER(38,0) NOT NULL,
    85|    in_subgraph         BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    86|    loaded_at           TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
    87|    CONSTRAINT pk_id_map_account PRIMARY KEY (account_id),
    88|    CONSTRAINT uk_id_map_account_src UNIQUE (src_bank_id, src_account_number),
    89|    CONSTRAINT fk_id_map_account_party FOREIGN KEY (party_id) REFERENCES ID_MAP_PARTY (party_id)
    90|)
    91|COMMENT = 'Deterministic (bank_id, account_number) -> account_id map. Composite key is required: AMLworld account numbers repeat across banks, and deriving from the number alone would merge distinct accounts and corrupt the counterparty graph.';
    92|
    93|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94|-- Leg-level transactions -- the table the pipeline actually reads.
    95|--
    96|-- One AMLworld pair row becomes two rows sharing txn_pair_id: a signed-negative
    97|-- debit and a signed-positive credit. Signed amounts make inflow and outflow a
    98|-- filter rather than a column, which keeps the velocity SQL simple.
    99|--
   100|-- Deliberately NOT present: is_laundering. See the header note.
   101|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   102|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_TRANSACTIONS (
   103|    txn_id                  VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'T-############-D|C.',
   104|    txn_pair_id             VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'Links the two legs of one transfer (GAP-03).',
   105|    leg_side                VARCHAR(1)      NOT NULL COMMENT 'D = debit (negative), C = credit (positive).',
   106|    account_id              VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'The account this leg posts to.',
   107|    counterparty_account_id VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'The other side. Resolvable by construction.',
   108|    txn_timestamp           TIMESTAMP_NTZ   NOT NULL,
   109|    amount                  NUMBER(20,2)    NOT NULL COMMENT 'Signed, in `currency`. Negative = debit.',
   110|    currency                VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'INR for ~95% of legs; the rest cross-border.',
   111|    amount_inr              NUMBER(20,2)    NOT NULL COMMENT 'Converted at the per-currency rate in conf/generation.yml. All threshold arithmetic uses this column.',
   112|    txn_type                VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'DEPOSIT | WITHDRAWAL | TRANSFER | PAYMENT.',
   113|    channel                 VARCHAR         NOT NULL COMMENT 'UPI | IMPS | NEFT | RTGS | CASH | CHEQUE.',
   114|    reference_text          VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Free-text narration. Synthetic.',
   115|    source_ref              VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Opaque UTR-like transfer reference, shared by both legs. Deliberately carries no provenance: a source/injected prefix or a source row number would be a label. Provenance is in GROUND_TRUTH.TXN_LABELS.',
   116|    ingested_at             TIMESTAMP_NTZ   DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL
   117|                                            COMMENT 'Arrival time. Differs from txn_timestamp under replay.',
   118|    CONSTRAINT pk_raw_transactions PRIMARY KEY (txn_id),
   119|    CONSTRAINT fk_raw_txn_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES ID_MAP_ACCOUNT (account_id)
   120|)
   121|CLUSTER BY (TO_DATE(txn_timestamp), account_id)
   122|COMMENT = 'Leg-level transaction ledger, INR-normalised. Append-only. Contains NO label column: it feeds the dynamic tables that feed the semantic view.';
   123|
   124|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125|-- Party attributes, split across two sources so the agent has to reconcile them.
   126|--
   127|-- A real institution holds the same customer in a core banking system and a KYC
   128|-- platform, and they disagree. Modelling that disagreement is the point: the
   129|-- L3 generator injects contradictions at a configured rate, and DT_DIM_PARTY
   130|-- has to resolve them.
   131|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   132|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_PARTY_CBS (
   133|    party_id            VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   134|    full_name           VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   135|    party_type          VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'INDIVIDUAL | LEGAL_PERSON.',
   136|    date_of_birth       DATE            COMMENT 'NULL for legal persons.',
   137|    incorporation_date  DATE            COMMENT 'NULL for individuals.',
   138|    nationality         VARCHAR,
   139|    branch_region       VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Row access policy discriminator.',
   140|    branch_code         VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   141|    customer_since      DATE,
   142|    status              VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'ACTIVE | DORMANT | CLOSED.',
   143|    loaded_at           TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
   144|    CONSTRAINT pk_raw_party_cbs PRIMARY KEY (party_id)
   145|)
   146|COMMENT = 'Core banking system view of the customer. System of record for identity and branch.';
   147|
   148|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_PARTY_KYC (
   149|    party_id                VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   150|    occupation              VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Deliberately stale for a configured share of parties.',
   151|    declared_annual_income  NUMBER(20,2)    COMMENT 'GAP-04: derived from observed legitimate inflow, not drawn at random, or INCOME_ACTIVITY_MISMATCH fires on everyone or no one.',
   152|    source_of_funds         VARCHAR,
   153|    risk_rating             VARCHAR         COMMENT 'LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH.',
   154|    pep_flag                BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
   155|    kyc_status              VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'VERIFIED | PENDING_REVIEW | EXPIRED.',
   156|    kyc_last_reviewed       DATE,
   157|    pan_number              VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Synthetic. Masked for non-privileged roles.',
   158|    aadhaar_last4           VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Synthetic. Masked for non-privileged roles.',
   159|    phone_number            VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Shared across parties by design -> SHARED_PHONE edges.',
   160|    kyc_note                VARCHAR         COMMENT 'L3 narrative. May contradict the structured record.',
   161|    loaded_at               TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
   162|    CONSTRAINT pk_raw_party_kyc PRIMARY KEY (party_id),
   163|    CONSTRAINT fk_raw_party_kyc_party FOREIGN KEY (party_id) REFERENCES RAW_PARTY_CBS (party_id)
   164|)
   165|COMMENT = 'KYC/CDD platform view. Source for income, PEP status and narrative notes.';
   166|
   167|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_ACCOUNTS (
   168|    account_id          VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   169|    party_id            VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   170|    account_type        VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'SAVINGS | CURRENT | LOAN | CREDIT_CARD | FD.',
   171|    opened_date         DATE    NOT NULL,
   172|    status              VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'ACTIVE | DORMANT | FROZEN | CLOSED.',
   173|    current_balance     NUMBER(20,2),
   174|    credit_limit        NUMBER(20,2)    COMMENT 'NULL unless a credit product.',
   175|    branch_region       VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Denormalised from the party for row-level filtering.',
   176|    branch_code         VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   177|    device_fingerprint  VARCHAR         COMMENT 'GAP-05: shared fingerprints are co-located with existing fund flows. Random assignment yields zero SHARED_DEVICE_CLUSTER hits, because that rule requires a shared device AND a flow between the accounts.',
   178|    loaded_at           TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
   179|    CONSTRAINT pk_raw_accounts PRIMARY KEY (account_id),
   180|    CONSTRAINT fk_raw_accounts_party FOREIGN KEY (party_id) REFERENCES RAW_PARTY_CBS (party_id)
   181|)
   182|COMMENT = 'Account master, enriched onto the preserved AMLworld account keys.';
   183|
   184|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   185|-- Generated relationship edges.
   186|--
   187|-- Attribute-based only (shared phone, shared device, beneficial ownership).
   188|-- FUND_FLOW edges are DERIVED from transactions in DT_PARTY_RELATIONSHIP and
   189|-- must never be generated here: a generated flow edge that no transaction
   190|-- supports would make graph evidence unverifiable.
   191|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   192|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_ATTR (
   193|    relationship_id     VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   194|    party_a_id          VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   195|    party_b_id          VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   196|    relationship_type   VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'SHARED_PHONE | SHARED_DEVICE | BENEFICIAL_OWNER.',
   197|    shared_value        VARCHAR         COMMENT 'The phone or fingerprint that links them. Evidence, not decoration.',
   198|    first_seen          TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
   199|    last_seen           TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
   200|    loaded_at           TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
   201|    CONSTRAINT pk_raw_party_rel_attr PRIMARY KEY (relationship_id)
   202|)
   203|COMMENT = 'Attribute-based relationship edges. FUND_FLOW is derived from transactions, not generated.';
   204|
   205|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   206|-- Sanctions landing.
   207|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   208|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_SANCTIONS_OPENSANCTIONS (
   209|    entry_id            VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'OpenSanctions entity id.',
   210|    schema_type         VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Person | Company | Organization | LegalEntity.',
   211|    entity_name         VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   212|    aliases_raw         VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Semicolon-delimited in source; split into an ARRAY downstream.',
   213|    birth_date_raw      VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Partial dates occur ("1975", "1975-03"); kept as text, parsed later.',
   214|    countries_raw       VARCHAR,
   215|    datasets_raw        VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Contributing source lists (OFAC, UN, EU, UK).',
   216|    first_seen          VARCHAR,
   217|    last_seen           VARCHAR,
   218|    last_change         VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Drives SANCTIONS_MATCH_NEW via the watermark table.',
   219|    list_version        VARCHAR         COMMENT 'Snapshot version. Required provenance for a screening hit.',
   220|    loaded_at           TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
   221|    CONSTRAINT pk_raw_sanctions_os PRIMARY KEY (entry_id)
   222|)
   223|COMMENT = 'OpenSanctions targets.simple.csv. CC-BY-NC-4.0: attribution required, non-commercial use.';
   224|
   225|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RAW_SANCTIONS_OFAC (
   226|    entry_id        VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   227|    entity_name     VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   228|    aliases_raw     VARCHAR,
   229|    sdn_type        VARCHAR,
   230|    programs_raw    VARCHAR COMMENT 'Sanctions programmes the entity is designated under.',
   231|    nationality     VARCHAR,

   239|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   240|-- GAP-11: sanctions screening watermark.
   241|--
   242|-- SANCTIONS_MATCH_NEW means "matches an entry added since the last check",
   243|-- which is not expressible without persisted state. Without this table the rule
   244|-- either re-fires on every refresh or never fires at all -- the architecture
   245|-- specified the rule but not the mechanism.
   246|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   247|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SANCTIONS_SCREENING_WATERMARK (
   248|    watermark_id            VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SINGLETON',

   252|    updated_at              TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,

   257|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   258|-- Policy clause staging. Extraction lands here and is NOT active until a human
   259|-- approves it (Diagram 10). An auto-activated regulatory change is exactly the

1|-- ===========================================================================
     2|-- 01_ddl / 04_audit_and_ground_truth.sql
     3|-- ===========================================================================
     4|-- Two schemas with opposite visibility rules:
     5|--
     6|--   AUDIT         written by the service role, read by compliance, never
     7|--                 updated or deleted by anyone.
     8|--   GROUND_TRUTH  granted to nobody but the admin role. The service role has no
     9|--                 USAGE on the schema, so no prompt can reach a label.
    10|-- ===========================================================================
    11|
    12|USE SCHEMA {{ fq.audit }};
    13|
    14|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    15|-- Every agent turn, in full.
    16|--
    17|-- The point is reconstructability: given a finding, this table must answer who
    18|-- asked, under which role, which tools ran, what SQL executed, which model and
    19|-- prompt produced the text, and what it cost. Anything less makes the
    20|-- "inspectable thread" claim unverifiable.
    21|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    22|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS AGENT_ACTION_LOG (
    23|    log_id              VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    24|    session_id          VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Groups the turns of one investigation.',
    25|    turn_number         NUMBER(10,0) NOT NULL,
    26|    agent_mode          VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'SENTINEL | INVESTIGATOR | DRAFTER | REVIEWER.',
    27|    invoked_by          VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'USER | TASK | AUTOMATION | MCP_CLIENT.',
    28|    snowflake_user      VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    29|    user_role           VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Effective role. Recorded because the row access policy makes the same question return different answers per role, and the answer is only interpretable alongside the role.',
    30|    question_text       VARCHAR,
    31|    tools_invoked       ARRAY   COMMENT 'Ordered tool calls for this turn.',
    32|    tool_arguments      VARIANT COMMENT 'Arguments per call, so a tool invocation can be replayed.',
    33|    sql_text            VARCHAR COMMENT 'Generated SQL, if any.',
    34|    sql_hash            VARCHAR,
    35|    snowflake_query_ids ARRAY   COMMENT 'For ACCOUNT_USAGE credit attribution.',
    36|    rows_touched        NUMBER(38,0),
    37|    evidence_ids_accessed ARRAY,
    38|    case_ids_touched    ARRAY,
    39|    model_version       VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Resolved model, not the configured preference.',
    40|    prompt_version      VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    41|    tokens_input        NUMBER(38,0),
    42|    tokens_output       NUMBER(38,0),
    43|    credits_estimated   NUMBER(20,8),
    44|    latency_ms          NUMBER(38,0),
    45|    outcome             VARCHAR COMMENT 'SUCCESS | REFUSED | ERROR | PARTIAL.',
    46|    refusal_reason      VARCHAR COMMENT 'Populated on REFUSED. A deliberate refusal is a feature, and the log is where it becomes demonstrable rather than anecdotal.',
    47|    error_text          VARCHAR,
    48|    logged_at           TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
    49|    CONSTRAINT pk_agent_action_log PRIMARY KEY (log_id)
    50|)
    51|COMMENT = 'Append-only audit trail of every agent turn. Never updated, never deleted.';
    52|
    53|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    54|-- Data-quality observations (Diagram 11, gate 6).
    55|--
    56|-- DMF results are surfaced here so the agent can qualify an answer -- "this is
    57|-- based on data 14 hours stale" -- instead of presenting stale output as
    58|-- current. A confident answer over stale data is the more dangerous failure.
    59|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    60|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DATA_QUALITY_LOG (
    61|    dq_log_id       VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    62|    object_name     VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    63|    metric_name     VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'NULL_RATE | ROW_COUNT | FRESHNESS_SECONDS | REFERENTIAL_ORPHANS | VOLUME_ANOMALY.',
    64|    metric_value    NUMBER(20,4),
    65|    threshold_value NUMBER(20,4),
    66|    breached        BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    67|    measured_at     TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
    68|    CONSTRAINT pk_data_quality_log PRIMARY KEY (dq_log_id)
    69|)
    70|COMMENT = 'Data metric function results. Lets the agent qualify an answer by data freshness.';
    71|
    72|-- ===========================================================================
    73|-- GROUND_TRUTH -- isolated. No consumer role has USAGE on this schema.
    74|-- ===========================================================================
    75|
    76|USE SCHEMA {{ fq.ground_truth }};
    77|
    78|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    79|-- GAP-08: leg-level labels.
    80|--
    81|-- AMLworld labels at PAIR grain, but the pipeline stores legs, so one labelled
    82|-- source row yields two labelled legs. The Patterns file identifies illicit
    83|-- transactions only by the tuple (timestamp, from_account, to_account, amount),
    84|-- which is not unique -- the same tuple recurs. match_confidence records how the
    85|-- label was attributed so an ambiguous match is visible in the metrics rather
    86|-- than quietly inflating them.
    87|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    88|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TXN_LABELS (
    89|    txn_id              VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Leg-level id. FK to RAW.RAW_TRANSACTIONS.',
    90|    txn_pair_id         VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    91|    src_row_number      NUMBER(38,0) COMMENT 'Source row. NULL for injected cohorts.',
    92|    is_illicit          BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    93|    typology_id         VARCHAR COMMENT 'FK to GOVERNANCE.TYPOLOGY. NULL when AMLworld flagged the row but the Patterns file did not attribute a typology.',
    94|    amlworld_pattern    VARCHAR COMMENT 'CYCLE | FAN-OUT | GATHER-SCATTER | ...',
    95|    attempt_id          NUMBER(38,0) COMMENT 'Groups the legs of one laundering attempt, so recall can be measured per attempt rather than per leg.',
    96|    injection_method    VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'amlworld_original | reskin_structuring | reskin_mule_fan_in | reskin_dormant_reactivation.',
    97|    match_confidence    NUMBER(5,4) COMMENT 'Confidence of the Patterns-to-leg attribution. 1.0 = unambiguous. Below 1.0 means the source tuple was not unique.',
    98|    inserted_at         TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
    99|    CONSTRAINT pk_txn_labels PRIMARY KEY (txn_id)
   100|)
   101|COMMENT = 'Leg-level ground truth. NEVER exposed in the semantic view, and no consumer role can read it.';
   102|
   103|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   104|-- GAP-08: the evaluation grain decision.
   105|--
   106|-- Labels are at transaction grain; signals fire at party-window or
   107|-- account-window grain. "F1 > 0.7 for structuring" has no meaning until a
   108|-- denominator is fixed. This table materialises the chosen grain -- party-month
   109|-- -- so the metric is defined by an artefact rather than by whatever the
   110|-- evaluation script happened to do.
   111|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   112|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS EVAL_GRAIN_PARTY_MONTH (
   113|    party_id            VARCHAR NOT NULL,
   114|    month_bucket        VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'YYYY-MM.',
   115|    typology_id         VARCHAR,
   116|    is_illicit_actual   BOOLEAN NOT NULL COMMENT 'True when any labelled illicit leg falls in this party-month.',
   117|    illicit_leg_count   NUMBER(38,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
   118|    total_leg_count     NUMBER(38,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
   119|    expected_rule_ids   ARRAY   COMMENT 'Rules that SHOULD fire for this typology. Makes per-rule recall computable instead of requiring a hand-written mapping in the test.',
   120|    built_at            TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
   121|    CONSTRAINT pk_eval_grain_party_month PRIMARY KEY (party_id, month_bucket)
   122|)
   123|COMMENT = 'Evaluation truth at party-month grain -- the declared denominator for precision and recall.';
   124|
   125|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   126|-- Injected legs whose amounts are not yet known.
   127|--
   128|-- Structuring deposits are generated as a FRACTION of the CTR threshold, not
   129|-- in rupees, so the threshold is resolved from POLICY_CLAUSE at load time rather
   130|-- than baked into generated data. `load` promotes each row into
   131|-- RAW.RAW_TRANSACTIONS with

    10|-- Two gaps are resolved structurally here:
    11|--
    12|-- GAP-11  Idempotency. A dynamic table recomputes its whole result set every
    13|--         refresh, so the same logical signal reappears every five minutes.

    15|--         it, the stream-plus-task design inserts duplicate cases forever.

    18|--         AT(TIMESTAMP=>) binds per table reference rather than per statement,
    19|--         and dynamic tables are not freely time-travellable. EVIDENCE_QUERY_LOG
    20|--         therefore stores a canonical result SNAPSHOT plus its hash. Recompute
    21|--         and compare is the correctness mechanism; Time Travel is the
    22|--         demonstrable provenance layer on top of it.

1|-- ===========================================================================
     2|-- 01_ddl / 02_governance.sql
     3|-- ===========================================================================
     4|-- Human-gated state: the regulatory thresholds, the typology catalogue, the
     5|-- rule registry and the filing templates.
     6|--
     7|-- POLICY_CLAUSE is the runtime source of truth for every threshold. Detection
     8|-- SQL joins to it rather than embedding a literal, which is what turns
     9|-- "policy-as-data" from a slide into a property of the system: changing the CTR
    10|-- threshold is a governed, effective-dated data change with an audit trail,
    11|-- not a code deploy.
    12|-- ===========================================================================
    13|
    14|USE SCHEMA {{ fq.governance }};
    15|
    16|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    17|-- Effective-dated regulatory and internal thresholds.
    18|--
    19|-- Seeded from conf/detection.yml, which carries the provenance that the deploy
    20|-- gate requires: a clause with no source_document is rejected, which is how the
    21|-- demo is prevented from citing a circular number that does not exist.
    22|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS POLICY_CLAUSE (
    24|    clause_id               VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    25|    clause_version          NUMBER(10,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    26|    source_document         VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'Real regulation or named internal document. Never blank.',
    27|    source_page             NUMBER(10,0),
    28|    section_heading         VARCHAR,
    29|    clause_text             VARCHAR COMMENT 'Quoted or paraphrased text, cited verbatim in findings.',
    30|    metric                  VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'What is measured, e.g. cash_txn_amount_inr.',
    31|    operator                VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT '>= | <= | = | BETWEEN.',
    32|    threshold_lower         NUMBER(20,4),
    33|    threshold_upper         NUMBER(20,4) COMMENT 'Populated only for BETWEEN.',
    34|    action_required         VARCHAR COMMENT 'FILE_CTR | FILE_STR | RAISE_SIGNAL | MANUAL_REVIEW | BLOCK_AND_ESCALATE | BLOCK_AUTO_FILING.',
    35|    effective_from          DATE    NOT NULL,
    36|    effective_to            DATE    COMMENT 'NULL = currently in force. Effective-dating lets a finding cite the clause that was in force on the transaction date, not today''s.',
    37|    supersedes_clause_id    VARCHAR,
    38|    approved_by             VARCHAR COMMENT 'Who promoted this clause. NULL only for the config-seeded baseline.',
    39|    approved_at             TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
    40|    created_at              TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
    41|    CONSTRAINT pk_policy_clause PRIMARY KEY (clause_id, clause_version)
    42|)
    43|COMMENT = 'Effective-dated thresholds. THE runtime source of truth: detection SQL joins here instead of hardcoding a number.';
    44|
    45|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    46|-- Current-clause convenience view. Detection SQL reads this so that no query
    47|-- has to remember the effective-dating predicate -- forgetting it would
    48|-- silently apply a superseded threshold.
    49|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    50|CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW V_POLICY_CLAUSE_CURRENT
    51|    COMMENT = 'Clauses in force today, latest version per clause_id.'
    52|AS
    53|SELECT *
    54|FROM POLICY_CLAUSE
    55|QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY clause_id ORDER BY clause_version DESC) = 1
    56|    AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE()
    57|    AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > CURRENT_DATE());
    58|
    59|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    60|-- Typology catalogue, anchored to real FATF / RBI references so a finding can
    61|-- name the laundering pattern it alleges rather than gesturing at one.
    62|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    63|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TYPOLOGY (
    64|    typology_id         VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    65|    name                VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'structuring | layering | mule_fan_in | cycle | ...',
    66|    fatf_reference      VARCHAR,
    67|    rbi_reference       VARCHAR,
    68|    description         VARCHAR,
    69|    detection_approach  VARCHAR COMMENT 'rules | graph | hybrid | ml.',
    70|    -- AMLworld labels patterns as CYCLE, FAN-OUT, GATHER-SCATTER and so on.
    71|    -- Storing that mapping here is what lets per-typology F1 be computed
    72|    -- without a hardcoded translation table in the eval script.
    73|    amlworld_pattern    VARCHAR COMMENT 'Corresponding HI-Small_Patterns.txt label, if any.',
    74|    created_at          TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() NOT NULL,
    75|    CONSTRAINT pk_typology PRIMARY KEY (typology_id)
    76|)
    77|COMMENT = 'Laundering typologies with regulatory citations and their AMLworld pattern names.';
    78|
    79|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    80|-- Rule registry. Versioned: a signal records which rule version fired, so a
    81|-- later threshold change cannot retroactively alter what a past finding claimed.
    82|-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    83|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RULE_DEFINITION (
    84|    rule_id             VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    85|    rule_version        NUMBER(10,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    86|    typology_id         VARCHAR COMMENT 'FK to TYPOLOGY.',
    87|    clause_ids          ARRAY   COMMENT 'Clauses this rule implements. A rule with no clause is an ungoverned rule and is rejected at deploy time.',
    88|    description         VARCHAR NOT NULL,

thinking.text:
I'm noting that this policy view uses CURRENT_DATE(), which raises a concern about whether non-deterministic functions like that are allowed in incremental dynamic tables or force a full refresh.

A better design might join on effective dates relative to transaction timestamp instead, which stays deterministic and correctly reflects the clause in force at that time — and window functions with QUALIFY should still work fine incrementally. I want to flag this refresh-mode question as a plan item to verify after creation, then move on to reading base.yml, dev.yml, cli.py, deploy.py, config.py, and the relevant design diagrams for more context.

    65|    origin = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()

     6|# Tier 3  Business rules   -> GOVERNANCE.POLICY_CLAUSE at runtime,
     7|#                             seeded from conf/detection.yml
     8|#
     9|# No .sql file may contain a literal database, schema, warehouse or role name.
    10|# Every SQL file is a Jinja template rendered by risk_copilot.pipeline.deploy
    11|# using the values below. This is what makes DEV / DEMO separation possible and
    12|# keeps the repo free of environment-specific identifiers.
    13|# ===========================================================================
    14|
    15|project:
    16|  name: risk_copilot
    17|  # Suffix appended to every object name, driven by the active profile.
    18|  # Empty in demo, "_DEV" in dev -- lets both live in one account safely.
    19|  object_suffix: ""
    20|
    21|database:
    22|  name: RISK_COPILOT
    23|
    24|schemas:
    25|  raw: RAW                      # immutable landing, append-only
    26|  curated: CURATED              # dynamic tables + dimensions
    27|  governance: GOVERNANCE        # POLICY_CLAUSE, TYPOLOGY, RULE_DEFINITION, REF_*
    28|  evidence: EVIDENCE_CHAIN      # SIGNAL .. ATTESTATION
    29|  audit: AUDIT                  # AGENT_ACTION_LOG
    30|  ground_truth: GROUND_TRUTH    # labels + eval sets. NEVER in the semantic view.
    31|  ml: ML                        # feature/scoring artefacts kept out of CURATED
    32|
    33|warehouses:
    34|  dev:
    35|    name: RC_DEV_WH
    36|    size: XSMALL
    37|    auto_suspend_secs: 60
    38|    purpose: Development, DDL, ad-hoc queries
    39|  pipeline:
    40|    name: RC_PIPELINE_WH
    41|    size: SMALL
    42|    auto_suspend_secs: 60
    43|    purpose: Dynamic table refresh and scheduled tasks
    44|  demo:
    45|    name: RC_DEMO_WH
    46|    size: SMALL
    47|    auto_suspend_secs: 120
    48|    purpose: Demo queries and agent execution
    49|
    50|roles:
    51|  admin: RC_ADMIN                       # owns all objects
    52|  service: RC_SERVICE_ROLE              # agents + automations
    53|  compliance_officer: COMPLIANCE_OFFICER # sees all data, may attest artifacts
    54|  # Branch analysts drive the row-access-policy demo: same question, two roles,
    55|  # two answers. Keys must match branch_region values in conf/generation.yml.
    56|  branch_analysts:
    57|    MUMBAI: BRANCH_ANALYST_MUMBAI
    58|    DELHI: BRANCH_ANALYST_DELHI
    59|
    60|stages:
    61|  data: DATA_STAGE               # source datasets (AMLworld, OpenSanctions)
    62|  policy_docs: POLICY_DOCS       # regulatory PDFs for AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT
    63|  generated: GENERATED_STAGE     # L1/L2/L3 generator output
    64|  scripts: SCRIPTS_STAGE         # Python stored-procedure payloads
    65|
    66|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    67|# Time Travel retention.
    68|# GAP-12 fix: the Reviewer's re-verification needs as_of_ts to still be
    69|# reachable. Default retention (1 day) silently expires evidence. Landing
    70|# tables are append-only so a longer window is cheap. Correctness does NOT
    71|# depend on this -- EVIDENCE_QUERY_LOG.result_snapshot is the source of truth;
    72|# Time Travel is the demonstrable provenance layer on top.
    73|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    74|retention:
    75|  landing_days: 14
    76|  evidence_days: 14
    77|  default_days: 1
    78|
    79|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    80|# Dynamic table target lags.
    81|# GAP-09/10 fix: velocity is decomposed into an incremental-safe daily
    82|# aggregate plus a narrow 1h table, instead of one full-refresh rolling-window
    83|# table. See conf/profiles/*.yml to override per environment.
    84|# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    85|dynamic_tables:
    86|  dim_party:              { name: DT_DIM_PARTY,              target_lag: 1 day }
    87|  transactions_enriched:  { name: DT_TRANSACTIONS_ENRICHED,  target_lag: 1 minute }
    88|  txn_daily_agg:          { name: DT_TXN_DAILY_AGG,          target_lag: DOWNSTREAM }
    89|  txn_velocity_1h:        { name: DT_TXN_VELOCITY_1H,        target_lag: DOWNSTREAM }
    90|  party_relationship:     { name: DT_PARTY_RELATIONSHIP,     target_lag: 1 day }
    91|  sanctions_consolidated: { name: DT_SANCTIONS_CONSOLIDATED, target_lag: DOWNSTREAM }
    92|  # Row-level, incremental-safe rules only.
    93|  signals_fast:           { name: DT_SIGNALS_FAST,           target_lag: 5 minutes }
    94|  # Aggregate + graph rules that cannot refresh incrementally.
    95|  signals_aggregate:      { name: DT_SIGNALS_AGGREGATE,      target_lag: 60 minutes }
    96|
    97|views:
    98|  # Non-materialised rolling windows summed from DT_TXN_DAILY_AGG buckets.
    99|  txn_velocity_features: V_TXN_VELOCITY_FEATURES
   100|  # Pair-level transaction view over the leg-level physical table (GAP-03).
   101|  transaction_pairs: V_TRANSACTION_PAIRS
   102|
   103|streams_tasks:
   104|  signals_stream: SIGNALS_STREAM
   105|  route_signals_task: ROUTE_SIGNALS
   106|  route_signals_schedule: 1 minute
   107|
   108|cortex:
   109|  search_service: REGULATORY_SEARCH_SVC
   110|  search_source_table: POLICY_CLAUSE_CHUNKS
   111|  search_target_lag: 1 hour
   112|  semantic_view: SV_RISK_COPILOT
   113|  agent: RISK_COPILOT_AGENT
   114|
